title: TCS NQT & Digital
blurb: TCS NQT and Digital prep: aptitude screen, service-round CS fundamentals, and the arrays, strings, math, and DP patterns TCS keeps asking.

steps.title: Aptitude screen
steps.summary: Quant, logical reasoning, and verbal questions in screening style.

steps.title: Verbal ability screen
steps.summary: Grammar, sentence correction, and reading comprehension asked in NQT verbal sections.

steps.title: SQL & database queries screen
steps.summary: Joins, grouping, and NULL semantics for database screening rounds.

steps.title: Two Sum
steps.summary: Store each value's index in a hash map and look up the complement in one pass.

steps.title: Majority Element
steps.summary: Boyer-Moore voting: cancel different pairs and the survivor is the majority.

steps.title: Move Zeroes
steps.summary: Slow write pointer collects the non-zeros; fill the tail with zeros.

steps.title: Valid Anagram
steps.summary: Compare character counts, or sort both strings and compare them.

steps.title: Missing Number
steps.summary: XOR all indices and values, or use the arithmetic sum formula.

steps.title: Find Pivot Index
steps.summary: Prefix sums: compare the left total against the running right total.

steps.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
steps.summary: Scan once, track the cheapest price seen so far, and update the best profit.

steps.title: Rotate Array
steps.summary: Reverse the whole array, then reverse each of the two parts.

steps.title: Valid Palindrome
steps.summary: Two pointers skip non-alphanumerics and compare characters inward.

steps.title: Reverse String
steps.summary: Swap characters from both ends until the pointers cross.

steps.title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
steps.summary: Slide the pattern across the text, comparing characters; return the first match.

steps.title: Roman to Integer
steps.summary: Scan left to right and subtract when a smaller numeral precedes a larger one.

steps.title: Palindrome Number
steps.summary: Reverse half the digits and compare, or build the reversed string.

steps.title: Add Binary
steps.summary: Simulate column addition from the least significant bit, carrying into the next column.

steps.title: Valid Parentheses
steps.summary: Push openers on a stack and require every closer to match the current top.

steps.title: Next Greater Entry
steps.summary: Monotonic stack over the larger array, keyed by value, answers each subset query.

steps.title: Reverse Linked List
steps.summary: Walk the list once, pointing each node back at its predecessor.

steps.title: Middle of the Linked List
steps.summary: Slow and fast pointers; the slow one lands on the middle when fast ends.

steps.title: Merge Sorted Array
steps.summary: Fill from the back so the larger tail value lands straight in its final slot.

steps.title: Sort Colors
steps.summary: Dutch national flag: three pointers partition the array into zeros, ones, and twos.

steps.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
steps.summary: Postorder: one plus the deeper of the two child heights.

steps.title: Same Tree
steps.summary: Compare node values while recursing into both pairs of children.

steps.title: Climbing Stairs
steps.summary: Each step count is the sum of the two previous counts; iterate with two variables.

steps.title: Fibonacci Number
steps.summary: Rolling two-value DP, or fast doubling when n grows large.

steps.title: Pascal's Triangle
steps.summary: Each row is the previous row's adjacent sums, padded with ones at both ends.

steps.title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
steps.summary: Kadane: keep the best sum ending here, restarting whenever it turns negative.

steps.title: House Robber
steps.summary: DP over houses: take the current plus two-back, or skip to the previous best.

steps.title: Min Stack
steps.summary: Auxiliary stack of running minima so every top and min query stays O(1).

steps.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
steps.summary: Min-heap of size k, or quickselect for average linear time.

steps.title: First and Last Position of a Target
steps.summary: Two binary searches: the leftmost and the rightmost occurrence of the target.

steps.title: First Unique Character in a String
steps.summary: Count characters, then rescan in order for the first count of one.

steps.title: Maximum Product Subarray
steps.summary: Track both the running max and min product, because a negative flips the sign.

steps.title: CS fundamentals screen
steps.summary: OS, DBMS, networks, and memory questions asked in service rounds.

steps.title: Arrays & hashing check
steps.summary: Frequency maps, indexing, and prefix sums under time pressure.

steps.title: Math & matrices check
steps.summary: Number properties, carry simulation, and matrix indexing.

steps.title: Final mock assessment
steps.summary: Timed mixed set across the whole bank, to test exam pacing.
